messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: Region steering anomaly detected — oscillating route weights between eu-west-1 and us-west-2 for route 'gen-api'. AlertID: RS-2141-OSC

emily: oncall emily here, investigating. brief status?

sanjay: saw the alert at 03:14 UTC. traffic flip every ~60s between eu-west-1 <-> us-west-2, 5xx spike and p50/p95 latency jump for EU clients. grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/gen-api-steering?from=now-30m

maria: support escalations coming in — several customers in EU reporting timeouts and retries. ticket INC-8322. hitting product alerts for rate-limited retries.

ops-bot: Deploy audit: steering-policy service rolled at 2141000800 commit abc123 by @luis. No automatic rollback triggered because error budget not reached.

emily: ok. immediate mitigation proposal:
- freeze steering rollout (disable new policy)
- apply a short static override to keep eu traffic in eu for 15m
- if stable, roll forward controlled rollback of policy commit

sanjay: on it. applying override now.

sanjay: applied override — Command run:
```
# CLI
rctl route override --route gen-api --region eu-west-1 --type static --duration 15m --reason "steering-oscillation"
```

sanjay: override acknowledged by control-plane, weights forced eu=100. watching.

kevin: joining — saw pager. what's the rough customer impact? SLA hits?

maria: some 503s and client retries, estimated 3% of EU traffic affected, a few premium customers reported degraded experience. No data exfil concerns.

emily: thanks. current state: override applied ~03:19 UTC, latency p95 for EU back down from ~1200ms to ~230ms. 5xx count trending down.

lucas: quick note on root cause hypothesis: new steering algorithm uses smoothed latency signals + aggressive hysteresis. under certain corridor patterns (intermittent egress congestion) it oversteps thresholds and flips routes repeatedly. looks like a feedback loop.

kevin: ok. next actions:
- keep override until policy is disabled (emily)
- disable steering-policy rollout (sanjay)
- open postmortem and include customer impact numbers (maria)
- schedule follow-up rollback of commit abc123 if telemetry doesn't stabilize after disable

sanjay: disabling steering policy now.

sanjay: disabled rollout flag in control-plane; change id: rollout_flag/steering_policy=false

ops-bot: change registered. No other active rollouts for steering.

emily: handing off — I need to hop into an incident call. kevin, you're primary now. summary in one line: override applied, rollout disabled, watching for 30m. escalate to SEs if premium customers still impacted.

kevin: got it. taking over. I'll monitor in #oncall-watch and update SL. ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident RS-2141-OSC acknowledged and status set to "mitigated". Monitoring will continue for 30m. If metrics relapse, incident will auto-reopen.

maria: creating INC tile and customer comms draft. I'll attach metrics and next steps.

kevin: thanks team. I'll coordinate the postmortem and ensure steering algorithm has additional guards before re-enable.

emily: back briefly — good work. keep me posted on handoff notes.

kevin: will do. leaving thread open until 2141004000 for final close.

incident-bot: timeline events logged: override applied 2141001140, rollout disabled 2141001160, mitigated 2141001180.
